name: Republic of Cuba in Arms (Ten Years' War)
alt: Republic in Arms of the Ten Years' War
First Republic of Cuba in Arms

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Spain
predecessors.text: Oriente, where 'On 10 October 1868, sugar mill owner Carlos Manuel de Céspedes and his followers proclaimed independence'

successors.name: Cuban Nationalists
successors.text: the eastern provinces, where the war resumed in 1895 as the second Republic in Arms (Cliopatria 'Cuban Nationalists', 1895-1899)

ledger.x: 10 October 1868: Céspedes proclaims Cuban independence (the Grito de Yara).
4 November 1868: Camagüey rises in arms (Las Clavellinas Uprising).
10 April 1869: the Assembly of Guáimaro adopts the first Constitution of Cuba.
10 February 1878: the Pact of Zanjón ends the war.
10 February 1878: the Republic in Arms ends at Zanjón.
February 1878: the first Republic in Arms ends.

wars.name: Ten Years' War
wars.outcome: Spanish victory: the Pact of Zanjón of 10 February 1878; Céspedes killed on 27 February 1874; Baraguá protest 15 March 1878; infobox '10 October 1868 – 28 May 1878'.

certainty.note: Guerrilla war: no frontier is described and the republic held no stable territory the pages name.
